The EMEA Transactional Business Planning & Insights Analyst plays an important role in supporting data-driven decision-making across Sony Pictures' International Home Entertainment business.
Working alongside the Senior Managers, the Analyst provides analytical support through the preparation of reports, dashboards, forecasting models and commercial insights that enable informed business decisions across EMEA.
This role is ideally suited to an inquisitive and technically capable analyst who enjoys working with large datasets, identifying trends and solving business problems through data. The successful candidate will help maintain the reporting and analytical infrastructure that supports Business Planning & Insights while continually looking for opportunities to improve reporting, automate processes and uncover new commercial insights.
Reporting to the Senior Manager, EMEA Transactional Business Planning & Insights, the Analyst will work closely with Commercial, Finance, Marketing, Research and Global colleagues to ensure accurate, timely and insightful analysis that supports forecasting, planning and retailer engagement.
Whilst knowledge of the Home Entertainment industry is beneficial, the role is primarily focused on analytical capability, technical skills and a proactive approach to problem solving. Industry knowledge and forecasting methodologies can be developed through experience within the role.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Reporting & Analytics**
* Produce regular and ad-hoc reports that support Commercial, Finance and Business Planning teams across EMEA.
* Build and maintain dashboards using Tableau, Power BI or similar reporting tools to provide clear and actionable business insights.
* Analyse large datasets to identify trends, opportunities, anomalies and emerging business issues.
* Develop reporting solutions that improve visibility of business performance and support data-driven decision-making.
* Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, timely and presented in a clear and meaningful way.
**Data Management & Business Intelligence**
* Maintain and validate datasets used across Business Planning & Insights activities, ensuring high levels of accuracy and consistency.
* Support the management of reporting databases and analytical models across multiple business areas.
* Perform regular data quality checks and investigate anomalies where identified.
* Assist in integrating multiple internal and external data sources to create meaningful commercial insights.
* Contribute to maintaining a single source of truth for Business Planning & Insights reporting.
**Forecasting & Commercial Support**
* Support the preparation and maintenance of forecasting models for New Release and Catalogue planning.
* Produce financial reports and variance analysis to support business planning activities.
* Assist with the preparation of analytical material for retailer meetings, Joint Business Planning sessions and commercial reviews.
* Provide analytical support for pricing, promotions and title performance evaluations.
* Support budget and forecasting submissions through accurate data preparation and model maintenance.
**Process Improvement & Automation**
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve reporting processes through automation and simplification.
* Develop more efficient reporting solutions using Excel, Tableau, SQL, Power BI or other analytical tools.
* Explore emerging technologies, including AI-assisted analytical tools, that could improve efficiency and insight generation.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across reporting, forecasting and analytical processes.
**Collaboration & Global Alignment**
* Build effective relationships across Commercial, Finance, Marketing, Research and Global teams.
* Support Senior Managers by preparing analysis and presentations for business reviews and customer meetings.
* Share insights and analytical findings clearly with colleagues across the business.
* Contribute to a collaborative culture focused on continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making.
**Knowledge**

* Experience working with large datasets and producing meaningful business insights.
* Exposure to business reporting, dashboards or performance analysis within a commercial environment.
* Solid grounding in financial planning, forecasting, and performance analytics.
* Experience in digital distribution, home entertainment, or global media strategy, with a strong understanding of the digital transactional home entertainment business, including commercial models and market drivers desired but not essential.
* Experience working across multiple international territories, with exposure to EMEA markets would be beneficial.
**Skills**
* Highly proficient in **Excel** and **PowerPoint**, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Experience using Tableau, Power BI or similar Business Intelligence tools.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying and manipulating data.
* Experience using reporting databases and data visualisation tools.
* Experience with Python, Alteryx or AI-enabled analytical tools would be advantageous but not essential.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of presenting findings to senior stakeholders with clarity and impact.

* **Analytical Thinking** - Able to interrogate complex datasets and identify meaningful commercial insights.
* **Curiosity** - Naturally inquisitive, enjoys asking questions and investigating the reasons behind business performance.
* **Problem Solving** - Able to identify opportunities for improvement and develop practical solutions.

The Information Security organization at Sony Pictures Entertainment is responsible for protecting our content, systems, and data from being stolen, damaged, or destroyed. To do so, we are continuously improving our tools, capabilities, and processes to stay ahead of evolving threats.
The Manager, Information Security Productions is accountable for operationalizing the Information Security Productions program across all SPE Intl productions. This includes driving consistent implementation of approved security standards, tools, and controls; ensuring data-driven visibility into production security risk; and supporting compliance and readiness reporting to leadership. Success in this role requires strong cross-functional collaboration across Information Security, IT, S3, and production teams to embed security into creative workflows without friction, while ensuring protection of SPE’s most valuable assets—our stories and intellectual property.
This role will also ensure program consistency with regional and global counterparts, contribute to automation and standardization of key controls, and support ongoing improvement of information security for production practices across the production lifecycle.
**Success in this role looks like:**
* Business leaders have near real-time visibility into production information security risk using meaningful, actionable metrics that drive timely and effective decision-making.
* Consistent application of approved tools, workflows, and controls across productions, ensuring compliance and readiness reporting aligns with studio KPIs.
* Production teams trust SPE to provide a secure, highly available, and easy-to-use digital production environment that safeguards our content and data.
* Information Security, Physical Security, and IT operate as unified partners to protect SPE productions from concept to archive.

* Monitor, analyze, and report on production security posture and key control performance metrics for each production.
* Partner with global InfoSec, Risk, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, Training, and Governance teams to align production needs with enterprise programs.
* Prepare and present dashboards and reports on security trends, compliance status, and improvement opportunities.
* Support the development of production-specific metrics and KPIs to measure control effectiveness.
* With IT and Physical Security, maintain security controls in place for productions to most effectively meet our business goals.

* Coordinate adoption of automated controls with productions, such as provisioning, watermarking, and access telemetry.
* Support the standardization and scalability of production security practices across production titles and business units.

* Amplify the reach of security training and awareness initiatives by coordinating rollout to productions, ensuring consistent messaging and participation tracking.
* Gather feedback from productions to help refine information security for productions training and awareness efforts.
* Partner with Incident Response to ensure clear communications, timely follow-up, and closure of corrective actions.
* Track cultural and operational readiness indicators (e.g., onboarding rates, reporting engagement, post-incident improvements) to measure program maturity and continuous improvement.
**What you have:**
* ​Typically 5+ years of relevant experience across Information Security, Information Technology, movie and television production, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of the technologies, tools and workflows used across movie and television production environments.
* Knowledge of the processes, tools and practices used to protect confidential and sensitive information throughout the production lifecycle.
* Familiarity with Information Security frameworks, standards and industry best practices, and an understanding of how they support business objectives is advantageous but not essential.
* Ability to develop, maintain and analyse meaningful metrics to measure programme and process effectiveness.
* Strong planning, organisational and analytical skills, with the ability to manage priorities effectively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with a range of stakeholders.

The role is responsible for managing the end-to-end security due diligence lifecycle, providing expert risk-based assessments of third parties, driving remediation activities, and supporting compliance with applicable regulatory frameworks including DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, and SWIFT's internal security standards.
## Key Responsibilities
### Security Due Diligence & Risk Assessment
* Lead the end-to-end third-party security due diligence process, from supplier onboarding through ongoing assurance, reassessment, and offboarding.
* Perform comprehensive security risk assessments of third parties, evaluating cybersecurity, resilience, data protection, cloud security, supply chain security, and operational risk exposures.
* Assess supplier security capabilities through review of questionnaires, policies, certifications, audit reports, penetration testing results, independent assurance reports, and supporting evidence.
* Evaluate control effectiveness against recognised frameworks and standards including ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, SOC reports, DORA, and relevant SWIFT security requirements.
* Identify security gaps, residual risks, and compensating controls, providing clear risk ratings and recommendations to stakeholders.
### Supplier Assurance & Continuous Monitoring
* Establish and maintain a risk-based supplier assurance programme for critical and high-risk third parties.
* Drive remediation activities with suppliers and internal stakeholders to address identified security weaknesses and control deficiencies.
* Support ongoing monitoring activities, including reassessments, threat monitoring, breach notifications, security events, and changes in supplier risk profiles.
* Monitor supplier compliance with contractual security obligations and regulatory requirements.
### Stakeholder Management & Advisory
* Partner closely with Procurement, Legal, Technology, Architecture, Operational Risk, Compliance, Data Protection, and Business teams to support supplier onboarding and risk decisions.
* Provide expert guidance on third-party security risks, risk acceptance decisions, mitigating controls, and supplier onboarding requirements.
* Present security due diligence outcomes, key risks, and recommendations to governance forums, senior management, and risk committees.
* Act as the subject matter expert for third-party security risk management and supplier assurance activities across the organisation.
### Governance & Regulatory Compliance
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of SWIFT's Third-Party Security Risk Management and Supplier Assurance frameworks, methodologies, standards, and procedures.
* Ensure due diligence activities align with regulatory expectations and industry best practices, including DORA, NIS2, GDPR, EBA Guidelines, and relevant financial sector requirements.
* Support internal audits, regulatory reviews, and external examinations relating to third-party security risk management.
* Develop management reporting, KPIs, KRIs, and board-level metrics to demonstrate programme effectiveness and risk exposure.

* Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Risk Management, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

* Strong understanding of third-party security risk management practices and supplier assurance methodologies.
* Practical experience conducting security assessments of cloud providers, SaaS vendors, technology suppliers, and outsourced service providers.
* Strong understanding of security frameworks and standards including ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 1/2, CIS Controls, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience evaluating security controls across identity management, network security, encryption, vulnerability management, incident response, resilience, data protection, and secure software development.
* Excellent risk analysis, stakeholder management, and report-writing skills.
* Ability to communicate complex security risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior executives.

* Experience in financial services, payments, or highly regulated environments.
* Familiarity with supply chain security, concentration risk, AI supplier assessments, and cloud service provider due diligence.

* Experience using Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) platforms and third-party risk management tools.

* Timely completion of third-party security assessments.

* Continuous improvement of the third-party security risk and supplier assurance programme.

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. **You Are**
You have spent over a decade building verification environment that catches the bugs that matter, not just hit coverage targets. You can architect a UVM environment from scratch, write the sequences that stress the design.
At Synopsys, you will work on interface IP that powers real silicon, and the verification environment you build will be the reason it works.
**What You'll Be Doing**
* Collaborate with design teams to define verification requirements and translate specs into test plans that cover functional, edge case, and performance scenarios
* Architect and implement UVM testbench environments, including agents, scoreboards, and reusable verification components for interface IP designs
* Write System Verilog test sequences and constrained random stimulus to stress designs and uncover corner cases before silicon
* Implement System Verilog Assertions for simulation-based functional verification and formal verification flows
* Build and analyze functional and code coverage metrics, identify gaps, and drive coverage closure
* Lead and mentor a team of verification engineers, teaching UVM methodology, debugging techniques, and testbench architecture best practices
**The Impact You Will Have**
* Deliver verified interface IP designs that meet tape out schedules and quality targets, directly enabling customer success in high-performance silicon
* Reduce verification cycle time and improve bug detection through well-architected testbenches and reusable verification IP
* Establish verification standards and methodologies that scale across multiple projects and teams
* Accelerate team productivity by mentoring engineers on UVM, formal verification, and advanced debugging techniques
* Catch critical design issues early in the development cycle, reducing costly respins and improving time to market
* Build verification environments that become reference implementations for future projects
**What You'll Need**
* Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Communication Engineering
* 12+ years of hands-on ASIC design verification experience with strong focus on UVM-based functional verification
* Deep expertise in System Verilog, including advanced testbench architecture, constrained random verification, and coverage-driven verification
* Proven experience implementing System Verilog Assertions for functional and formal verification flows
* Strong programming skills in at least two of: C, System Verilog, TCL, Perl, or Python
* Experience with PCI Express and CXL protocols is a strong plus
* Experience in interface IP verification, formal verification tools like Jasper or VC Formal, and AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor or GitHub Copilot will set you apart
**Who You Are**
* You can spot a verification gap in a design review that no one else flagged and articulate why it matters in a way that gets it prioritized
* You review code with enough precision that engineers know exactly what to fix and enough respect that they want to do better next time
* You do not wait for perfect information to start building. You work with what you have, ask the right questions, and move forward
* Teaching comes naturally. You can explain UVM factory overrides or coverage bin construction in a way that makes a junior engineer understand it

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

#### Join the Future of Data & Analytics at The Ardonagh Group
The Ardonagh Analytics Lab is an exciting new operation established by The Ardonagh Group in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath. As a centre of excellence for data and analytics, the Lab delivers data-driven insights that support colleagues and clients across the globe.
With more than 12,000 colleagues operating across a diverse portfolio of insurance products and related services, Ardonagh is committed to using data to transform decision-making, enhance client outcomes, and build a deeper understanding of risk.
Our mission is simple: use data, analytics, and innovation to achieve better outcomes for every participant in the value chain. We explore vast and complex datasets, uncover hidden opportunities, model future scenarios, and help clients and insurer partners prepare for the unknown.
We're now looking for an experienced **Data Analyst** to join our growing Analytics Team and play a pivotal role in turning data into meaningful business insight.

As a key member of the Data Analytics Team, you will work across a variety of datasets to both respond to business requests and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance across the Group.
You will bridge the gap between our Data Engineering and Data Visualisation teams, ensuring that data is transformed into valuable insights that drive decision-making, operational efficiency, and commercial success.
This is a fantastic opportunity for an analytically curious professional who enjoys solving complex business problems and influencing strategic decisions through data.
#### What You'll Be Doing
* Translate complex data into actionable insights that inform decision-making, solve business challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and efficiency.
* Partner closely with Data Engineering and Data Visualisation teams to understand available data sources and maximise their business value.
* Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities within large datasets and provide recommendations that support strategic business decisions.
* Enhance automated reporting and dashboards through proactive analysis, meaningful commentary, and actionable recommendations.
* Support the development and implementation of robust data governance, management, and reporting processes across the Group.
* Explore and apply AI and machine learning techniques where appropriate to drive innovation and enhance business insight.
* Contribute to the continued development of a world-class analytics function within the Ardonagh Analytics Lab.
#### What We're Looking For
##### Essential Experience & Qualifications
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years' experience in data analysis and reporting.
* Strong SQL expertise, including data querying, mining, manipulation, and segmentation.
* Advanced quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex datasets.
* At least 2 years' experience using statistical programming languages such as Python or R.
* Solid understanding of database concepts, structures, and data modelling.
* Strong knowledge of Business Intelligence principles and analytical best practices.
* Experience with one or more BI tools, including Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
##### Desirable Experience
* Experience within financial services.
* Previous exposure to General Insurance is highly advantageous.
* Knowledge of predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-based analytical techniques.
#### About You
We're looking for someone who:
* Is an experienced analytics professional capable of working independently and taking ownership of outcomes.
* Brings a proactive, solutions-focused mindset and thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Has a genuine passion for transforming data into business value.
* Quickly builds an understanding of business operations and technical environments.
* Is a strong relationship builder who can confidently engage with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
* Combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication and influencing skills.
#### Why Join Us?
At the Ardonagh Analytics Lab, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging, high-impact projects that influence decision-making across a global organisation. You'll join a collaborative team passionate about innovation, continuous learning, and unlocking the power of data to shape the future of insurance.
If you're excited by the opportunity to turn complex data into meaningful business outcomes and want to be part of a growing analytics centre of excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

# Project Manager (Strategic Delivery)
## As part of the Strategic Delivery team, you will collaborate across the business to support programmes and projects aligned with our strategic drivers and long-term vision.
#### **Location**
Hybrid - 1-2 days in the office per week, 3-4 days spent working from home.
---
#### Why The Works?
##### We don’t just sell products. We inspire reading, learning, creativity and play.
**The Works**. It literally means everything. And whatever your story or background, we’re all about unlocking imagination and making creativity accessible to everyone. Whether you’re engaging with customers on the frontline or supporting our colleagues behind the scenes, your impact can be profound and far-reaching.
This is more than toys and books and art supplies. This is about inspiring people to read, learn, create and play. So, with the right passion, **it all starts with you.**
---
#### Become a Strategic Delivery Project Manager
Working hand in hand with teams across the organisation, you'll bring people together around shared goals, helping to coordinate strategic initiatives, projects and business priorities that support our strategy and drive positive change. This role acts as the central point of project oversight and coordination across a portfolio of strategic initiatives, ensuring projects remain aligned to business objectives, delivery commitments and business priorities. The Strategic Delivery Project Manager works closely with project sponsors, subject matter experts (SMEs), business leaders and project leads to support successful delivery, manage interdependencies, identify risks, and maintain momentum across the wider transformation agenda.
The role champions a transformation mindset, promotes effective project governance, and supports the embedding of sustainable change into business-as-usual (BAU) operations.
---
#### Your Mission
**Strategic Delivery & Coordination**
* Coordinate and maintain delivery plans across multiple strategic initiatives.
* Support project sponsors, SMEs and project managers in delivering agreed outcomes within defined timescales.
* Ensure projects remain aligned to organisational strategic priorities and business objectives.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to manage dependencies, priorities and resource requirements.
* Track key milestones, deliverables and dependencies across strategic projects and business initiatives.
* Identify, monitor and proactively escalate risks, issues and dependencies that may impact successful delivery.
* Support the successful adoption and embedding of change into BAU operations.
* Lead lessons-learned activities and promote continuous improvement across projects and initiatives.
* Support project governance, prioritisation and reporting activities, ensuring stakeholders have clear visibility of progress, risks and opportunities.
**Governance & Reporting**
* Produce clear, concise reporting and dashboards for senior stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Monitor project outcomes and support teams in measuring the value delivered.
* Work closely with our finance team to support financial tracking, delivery reporting and progress reviews where required.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date reporting across strategic projects and business initiative
* Ensure agreed delivery and governance processes are consistently applied across projects.
**Strategic Alignment & Business Value**
* Ensure strategic initiatives have clear objectives, success measures and strategic alignment.
* Monitor and report on benefits realisation throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support business leaders in evaluating delivery options, priorities and potential trade-offs.
* Help ensure investments deliver measurable business value and sustainable outcomes.
**Stakeholder Engagement & Influencing**
* Build strong relationships with project sponsors, SMEs, project managers and senior stakeholders.
* Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across business and technical teams.
* Influence stakeholders at all levels to remove barriers, resolve issues and maintain delivery momentum.
* Provide guidance and support to teams on project delivery best practice.
* Act as a trusted partner across the business, helping turn strategic priorities into successful outcomes.
**Change & Continuous Improvement**
* Champion a positive change culture that encourages innovation, collaboration and accountability.
* Support adoption of new processes, systems and ways of working.
* Promote continuous improvement across project delivery methodologies, governance and reporting.
* Share best practice and lessons learned to strengthen organisational capability.
* Encourage a delivery-focused mindset that balances pace, quality and business value.
---
### Skills/Behaviours That Will Set You Apart
* Proven experience coordinating projects and business initiatives, bringing together multiple teams and stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.
* Delivery of complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
* Brilliant organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior leaders.
* Commercial and strategic awareness, with the ability to connect project activity to wider business goals.
* Experience managing risks, issues, dependencies and competing priorities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex information.
* Analytical skills with a data-driven approach to reporting and decision-making.
* Experience using project management tools such as Monday.com, MS Project or similar.
* Understanding of project governance, project delivery and change management principles.
* Knowledge of change management methodologies and supporting organisational change.
* Experience within a retail or multi-site environment desirable.
* Experience supporting large-scale business change, transformation initiatives or strategic projects advantageous.
* Relevant certifications such as APM, PRINCE2, PMP, Agile or equivalent are desirable.
---
### Our PERKS really are ‘The Works’
* **💪 25% Colleague Discount!** - Plus, exclusive Double Discount days!
* 😎 **MyWorks** - Access exclusive online discounts across hundreds of retailers, holidays, utilities deals, tech and more
* 🏡 **Family Friendly Leave**- Enjoy some time well spent with enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.
* **🚀 Holiday** – 33 days including bank holidays.
* **💃 Holiday Purchase** - Purchase an additional 5 days
* **🎓 Can-Do Academy** - Grow your skills and career with instant access to further training and development in areas that interest you.
* **💸 Stream** - Claim early access to 50% of your wages as you earn them – for when ‘life’ happens!
* **🏬 Share Scheme** - Unleash your inner Monopoly mogul and own a piece of The Works!
* 💛 **24/7 support for you and your family** - Through our partnership with the Retail Trust who provide an Employee Assistance Programme and so much more!
* **🩺 Healthcare Cash Plan** – To support your everyday healthcare costs
* **🥳 And loads more!** – Long Service Awards, pension, life assurance, Cycle to Work and optional charity giving.
---

To inspire reading, learning, creativity and play 💛💙

We are **Crafty 🎨** | Smart with what we've got.

Each year, we run an anonymous colleague engagement survey. This is so important for us to hear your feedback and suggestions. We want to know what’s going great, and what needs a couple of tweaks to help make The Works the best place you’ve ever worked! You’ll have opportunity to help give us that direction.

# Data Architect
Belfast, Northern Ireland, United Kingdom
**Join TRG Screen: Building World-Class Teams. One Expert at a Time.**
Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team at the forefront of subscription spend management innovation?
At TRG Screen, we're not just redefining how organizations manage their subscription expenses – we're shaping the future of the industry. With cutting-edge solutions and a commitment to excellence, we empower businesses around the globe to optimize their subscription investments and drive sustainable growth.
Join us in our mission to revolutionize subscription management and make a meaningful impact on the way businesses access and utilize critical information. At TRG Screen, your talent and ambition will find a home, where opportunities for growth and advancement abound.
**About TRG Screen**
TRG Screen is the leading provider of market data and subscription management technology and automation solutions, tailored to the unique needs of financial institutions and legal firms. Our integrated suite of solutions includes market data and subscription spend management, usage management, compliance reporting, and comprehensive managed services, which hundreds of clients worldwide use to remove cumbersome and inaccurate manual processes and gain control over market data and subscription costs at scale. For more than 25 years, TRG Screen has enabled businesses who rely on market data to monitor and strategically manage spending and usage of data and information services, including market data, research, software licenses, consulting and other necessary corporate expenses. TRG Screen solutions give decisionmakers full transparency into subscription spend and usage, enabling them to proactively manage subscription costs at scale, conduct more informed vendor negotiations, improve governance, and avoid unnecessary spending on these mission-critical business services. TRG Screen is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Europe and Asia, as well as a 24x7 client support center in Bangalore, India.
TRG Screen is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s largest and most respected private equity firms.
**The Role**
Our data spans multiple products, including spend analytics, contracts, invoicing, market data inventory, and real-time telemetry, but it currently sits in separate, disconnected domains. We are bringing this together into a unified, governed, multi-tenant Lakehouse to enable cross-product analytics, customer benchmarking, and AI-driven innovation. We are looking for a **Data Architect** to define how our data is structured, connected, and governed, making sure it is consistent, trusted, and easy to discover across the organisation.This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and a real opportunity to shape how TRG Screen uses data going forward.
**Responsibilities**
Data architecture
* Author the canonical data model across the ten-product estate: logical and physical modelling, entity relationships, SCDs, and tenant isolation patterns.
* Define data contracts with product teams; own the data dictionary, naming standards, and reference-data discipline.
* Lead master data management - entity resolution, golden records, and cross-product joins at scale
* Define data domains, ownership boundaries, and federated governance suited to a product-aligned organization.
* Design the semantic/query layer (Dremio) for analysts, products, customers, and AI agents; set governance standards covering cataloguing, lineage, quality, access control, and PII.
Lakehouse architecture
* Define the Lakehouse target architecture: storage, table format, query engine, ingestion, metadata, and the standards that govern it.
* Set the patterns for multi-tenant isolation, row- and column-level security, and PII handling.
* Define the streaming and batch ingestion architecture, building on our investments in NATS JetStream, Apache Flink, and Debezium CDC patterns, and direct the engineering team on execution.
* Specify the catalog, lineage, and data-quality foundation and own the operational practice that keeps them honest.
* Make the build-vs-buy and tool selection calls, including revisiting current technology bets where the data warrants it.
Strategy and partnership
* Partner with the Director of Data Solutions to ensure the architecture delivers against the product roadmap.
* Represent data architecture in design reviews and customer-facing conversations.
* Establish the architecture practice: patterns, review forums, hiring standard, as the team continues to expand.
**Skills and Qualifications**
Required
* 8–10+ years in data / information architecture at a multi-product SaaS company.
* Deep expertise in conceptual / logical / physical data modelling, master data management, and domain-oriented governance.
* Proven track record reconciling semantically divergent source systems into canonical models across multiple products.
* Strong grounding in Lakehouse architecture trade-offs: table formats, query engines, ingestion patterns (Iceberg vs Delta; Dremio vs Trino vs Snowflake; streaming vs batch).
* Hands-on experience with:
+ Dremio, Snowflake, or Databricks
+ AWS data services (S3, Glue, Athena, Lake Formation, or equivalent)
+ NATS / Apache Kafka or similar, and CDC patterns (Debezium or equivalent)
+ Stream processing (Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, or equivalent)
+ SQL and query optimisation at scale
+ Data and table formats (Parquet, Avro, Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake)
* Experience designing SaaS data models, tenant isolation, shared schemas, access patterns, at scale.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions to engineers, product leadership, and executives.
Strongly preferred
* Market data, financial services, or enterprise software-licensing domain experience.
* Familiarity with modern data catalog and lineage tools, and the operational reality of running them at scale (DataHub, OpenMetadata, Atlan, Glue Catalog or equivalent).
* Experience designing data products that feed AI and agentic use cases, such as, vector stores, RAG, embeddings, tool surfaces.
* Python for data pipeline scripting and orchestration.
* Exposure to real-time analytics use cases - dashboards, alerting, and anomaly detection.

# Software Architect (C# / .NET)
## About the role
We're looking for a software architect who can work across very different kinds of systems. On any given week you might be defining the shape of a new service, untangling an integration between two platforms that were never meant to talk to each other, and reviewing someone else's design for a data-heavy batch process. The range is the job. If you've only ever architected one type of application, this will be a stretch. A lot of the work happens in conversation. You'll be in requirement sessions with stakeholders, in architecture review board meetings defending or revising proposals, and in the middle of a Teams thread where two engineers disagree about the right approach. You need to be the person who can absorb a half-formed business requirement and come back with something the team can actually build. This is a technical authority role. You won't manage people or own a budget, but your decisions will shape what several teams build for years.
## Responsibilities
* Own architecture decisions across multiple systems and document them, along with the trade-offs and what you rejected
* Present designs at architecture review board meetings, and review proposals from others with the same rigor
* Translate business requirements into technical designs, working directly with stakeholders and product
* Write product backlog items with enough technical clarity that a team can pick them up without a follow-up meeting
* Break down epics and large initiatives into deliverable pieces
* Provide estimates for architecture and delivery work, and be honest about what's uncertain
* Serve as the technical escalation point across teams, resolving design questions and unblocking engineers
* Define non-functional requirements: performance, scalability, security, availability, and cost
* Set reference architectures, standards, and patterns, and keep them alive rather than letting them rot in a wiki
* Evaluate technologies and build proofs of concept before committing teams to a direction
* Review critical code and designs, especially at integration and system boundaries
* Guide modernization of existing systems, deciding what to replace, what to wrap, and what to leave alone
* Keep architecture aligned with where the business is actually going
## Requirements
* 8+ years in software development, with several years in an architect or principal engineer role
* Deep C# / .NET expertise across modern .NET and older .NET Framework codebases
* Demonstrated experience architecting **different types of systems**: web applications, APIs and services, integrations, batch and data processing, and event-driven workloads
* Distributed systems design, including the failure modes that come with it
* Integration architecture: REST, messaging, queues, and dealing with systems you don't control
* Relational data modeling and SQL Server, plus a working knowledge of NoSQL and when it's the right call
* Cloud architecture, preferably Azure, including cost as a design constraint
* Security fundamentals: authentication, authorization, data protection, and secure design practices
* Experience writing backlog items and estimating work in an agile delivery environment
* Strong written communication. Your designs will be read by people who weren't in the room
* Strong spoken English, and the presence to hold your position in a review meeting without making it personal
* Bachelor's in Computer Science or equivalent experience
## Preferred
* Experience in a formal architecture governance or review board process
* Legacy modernization and migration at scale
* Domain-driven design
* Infrastructure as code and CI/CD architecture
* Experience setting standards for AI-assisted development across teams
* Exposure to a second stack beyond .NET, and the perspective that comes with it
## What we're looking for
Someone adaptable enough to be useful on a system they saw for the first time this morning. Someone who designs for the team that has to build it, not for the diagram. And someone who can disagree with a stakeholder clearly, early, and without burning the relationship.

# Sr. Backend Engineer (C# / .NET)
## About the role
We're looking for a senior backend engineer who is genuinely strong in C#. Not someone who can get things working, but someone who understands the language and the runtime well enough to make good calls about how our code is built and shared. A big part of this role is our internal NuGet packages. We have shared libraries that other teams depend on, and how those are designed, versioned, and released has a direct effect on how fast everyone else moves. We want someone who takes that seriously: clean public APIs, sane versioning, no surprise breaking changes. We work AI-first. Cursor is our primary development environment, and we expect you to be productive in it from the start. That means using it for real work, not just autocomplete, and knowing where it helps and where it gets in the way.
## Responsibilities
* Design and build complex backend components and services in C#
* Own internal NuGet packages end to end: API design, semantic versioning, release process, deprecation, and keeping consumers unblocked
* Set direction on shared code and libraries so teams aren't solving the same problem five different ways
* Review code and advise other engineers on approach, patterns, and trade-offs
* Build and maintain integrations and data exchange between internal platforms and third-party systems
* Test and debug thoroughly, including performance and behavior under load
* Work with product, QA, and other engineering teams to scope and resolve issues
* Provide technical leadership on projects and help keep delivery on track
## Requirements
* 5-7 years building backend systems in C# / .NET
* Deep C# knowledge: async/await and its pitfalls, memory and allocation behavior, generics, LINQ, dependency injection, and where each of these gets people into trouble
* Hands-on experience authoring and publishing NuGet packages, including private feeds (Azure Artifacts, GitHub Packages, or similar), semantic versioning, and managing breaking changes across consumers
* Strong API design instincts. You've maintained something other engineers depend on and have opinions about what makes that pleasant or painful
* Daily, hands-on experience with Cursor as a primary development environment. You should be comfortable with composer and multi-file edits, giving the model the right context from the codebase, setting up project rules, and reviewing generated code critically enough to catch what it gets wrong
* Judgment about when to reach for the AI and when to just write the code yourself
* REST API design and implementation
* SQL Server or comparable relational database, including query performance
* CI/CD pipelines and automated build and release processes
* Testing discipline: unit and integration tests, and knowing which is worth writing where
* Git, and experience in a code review culture
* Bachelor's in Computer Science or equivalent experience
## Preferred
* Experience with other AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Windsurf) and a view on how they compare
* .NET performance profiling and optimization
* Azure
* Message queues and event-driven architecture
* Experience mentoring or leading a small team
## What we're looking for
Someone with real technical judgment, who can tell the difference between a problem worth solving properly and one that just needs to ship. Someone who writes code other engineers are glad to inherit. And someone who can explain a technical decision clearly enough that people who disagree at least understand why you made it.

**We're really ambitious. Our vision is lively, buzzing communities in cities across the UK and the world, and a service so useful our members can't do their jobs without it. We're not saving the world, but we've seen what this does for people. Without us, a lot of them have no structured development, can't reach their potential, and find professional life very lonely.**
### **The role**
You’ll own courses - this is your product! You'll own the vision for them, how they grow, how we make people obsess over the product - this is all yours to run with!
We're not asking you to arrive and tear up something that works, and we're not asking you to leave it alone either. We want someone who understands why it works, then makes it something people can't imagine not paying for.
**What exists and works:**
* The Marketing Accelerator - our marketing leadership course for marketers looking for a promotion to head of.
* Brand Manager Boot Camp - teaches the marketing fundamentals for junior marketers looking to become brand managers.
* A course playbook we trust. We’ve spent years working out our secret for running amazing courses which are uniquely us (graduation dinners, group coaching)
* Three coaches who are genuinely great
* Lottie as the teacher!
**What doesn't exist yet:**
* We're dreaming of an AI course to kick off at the start of 2027 - we want to be the people startup marketers come to for that rather than the people catching up... this is for you to create!!
* Short, specific courses.. We think there's something in running focused mini-courses on CRM, paid ads and social with Brand Hackers, our sister agency. It's an idea rather than a plan, and we'd love someone to go and prove it.
* Up Academy. If all of that works, courses stop being a thing Up World does and become a business in their own right. We're not going to pretend that's a promise. It's where this could go, and you'd be the person taking it there.
You'll report to our Head of Up World. They set the direction for Up World as a whole and hold the commercial picture. Inside courses, the direction is yours.
## **What you'll own**
**The numbers**
* £100k of course revenue today, and the job of doubling it. Cohorts currently run at 20 to 25 people. We think 40 is possible.
* Pricing, and the argument for changing it.
* The funnel. Launch campaigns, warm leads, paid, the landing pages, the follow-up. You'll brief our freelancers and hold the quality, and you'll write the thing yourself when it's faster.
**The product**
* **The ladder.** Boot Camp takes a junior marketer to brand manager. The Accelerator takes a manager to head of. What sits before, between and after those is yours to decide.
* **What's actually in them.** Curriculum, the sessions, who teaches what, the materials, and the podcast alongside. Marketing changes fast and the content has to keep up.
* **The bits that make them uniquely us.** The coaching, the IRL day, the graduation dinner. Yours to keep sharp, and to change if you think there's something better.
* **The promise.** These courses exist to get people promoted. Owning them means knowing whether that happened, chasing the outcome months later, and being able to say what proportion of a cohort moved and where they went. That's the product, and it's the best marketing we have.
**The delivery**
* Running of the courses. Enrolment, comms, materials, the sessions, the IRL day, the dinner, the feedback afterwards.
* The coaches. Managing the three we have, bringing in the ones we need, and holding the standard.
* Course feedback is the best thing we have. Keeping it there while cohorts get bigger is harder than it sounds, and it's on you.
**Automations & AI**
* Four cohorts a year on your own only works if the repeatable parts run themselves. We use Claude, HubSpot, Mailchimp and Zapier, and some of it is elegant and some of it is held together with hope.
* Finding the work that shouldn't be done by a person. Reporting, cohort trackers, enrolment sequences, chasing, updating. If you're doing it by hand for the fourth time, that's the flag.
* Using AI properly rather than performatively. We're a small team doing the work of a bigger one, and that only holds if we're genuinely good at this. What you learn feeds the AI course you'll be selling.
### **About you**
You get a kick out of putting people in a room together and would sooner spend an afternoon building the automation than do the same task forty times. You like variety, because no two weeks here look the same. You're happy being the brain in the middle, briefing a designer, a copywriter and a paid specialist rather than doing all of it yourself. You can take a half-formed idea and come back with a plan, a timeline and a view on whether it's worth doing. And you'd rather look at what the numbers say and change course than defend a decision you've already made.
This is a job with real ownership in it. You're not passing the good bits to someone else, and you're not being handed a tidy machine to keep ticking over.
* **You've launched a paid product and sold it.** From the idea to the first person paying for it.
* **You're comfortable selling.** Most of this job is getting someone from curious to paid, on a call, in a launch, or across a room, and you don't find that awkward.
* **You can market it as well as build it.** You've written the launch emails, briefed the ads, and watched a funnel not work and fixed it.
* **You've run something from start to end.** A cohort, a programme, a season, an event series. You know the difference between planning it and the fortnight before it goes live.
* **A systems brain.** You've built automations other people now rely on, and you're already using AI to do parts of your job rather than reading about it.
* **You're happy owning a number,** and honest when it's going the wrong way. You'd tell us in week three, not at the end of the quarter.
* **Comfortable moving fast with imperfect information.** This is a small team and progress beats polish most weeks.
* **An interest in startup marketing and the people doing it.** You'll be in a room with them constantly, and the product only works if you like them.
Tools we use: Claude, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Zapier.
### What we offer...
This role is London-based. We operate as a remote-first company, but you’ll have access to co-working spaces and we expect you to be at team meetings and events **once a month** in real life. This is a full-time, permanent role.

# **Business Development Manager - Hellenic Systems Ltd**
**Location:** Home-based, anywhere in the UK, with regular travel to customer sites and periodic visits to our Essex head office
**About Hellenic Systems**
Founded in 1988, Hellenic Systems Ltd builds the systems that run the factory floor. Our software tells operators what to make and in what order, records what actually happened, and proves it to an auditor afterwards. The industry name for this is Manufacturing Execution Systems, or MES: the layer that sits between a company’s business systems and the machinery and people producing the goods. We design and manufacture the hardware that goes with it as well.
We are UK-based and serve over 130 sites across the UK and Europe. Our roots are in food manufacturing, particularly meat and poultry, and we are now extending into any manufacturer with the same problem to solve. A large share of what we ship is built specifically for one customer, which is why our tagline, Built Around You, is meant literally.
Our three software products are CARCASE, our kill line and livestock system, FOPS, our Factory Order Processing System, and FORMIX, our recipe and formulation management system. Our hardware includes weigh scales, touch screen terminals, outer case marking systems, carcass data capture units and label printers.
Since 2023 we have been part of Vesta Software Group, which sits within Jonas Software, an operating group of Constellation Software Inc. Constellation is one of the largest acquirers of vertical market software businesses in the world.
We are also unusually far along with AI for a business our size. It is embedded in how we build software and how we work day to day, not run as a side project, and we expect everyone here to use it.
**The Opportunity**
FORMIX, our recipe and formulation management system, has been rebuilt as a new product and is our main new business push. It guides operators through ingredient weigh-up, enforces tolerances, captures batch and operator evidence, and connects to shop floor weighing and labelling hardware. The buyers are food and drink manufacturers who still run weigh-up on paper, spreadsheets or an awkward ERP screen, and who are under real pressure on allergen control, traceability and waste.
This is a new role. It exists to build and convert a new business pipeline that does not depend on our existing account base.
**Job Summary**
The Business Development Manager owns new business at Hellenic. The role is targeted on winning new named clients and new sites, starting with FORMIX and broadening into our wider software and hardware portfolio as the pipeline develops. It is a hunting role: self-generated prospecting, campaigns and networking, then running the opportunity through demonstration, proposal, negotiation and close, with support from our technical and commercial teams.
The BDM reports to the Head of Commercial and works alongside our Account Managers, who own existing customer relationships. Growth inside existing accounts stays with them. Anything genuinely new belongs to the BDM.
**Key Responsibilities**
1. New Business Generation
* Win new named clients and new sites, principally for FORMIX in year one, broadening into CARCASE, FOPS, hardware and bespoke development as the pipeline matures.
* Generate the majority of your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold calling, email and LinkedIn campaigns, trade events and industry networking. Marketing and referral leads will supplement this, not replace it.
* Work the named FORMIX prospect list and the wider addressable market, including manufacturers outside our traditional meat and poultry base, such as bakery, dairy, ready meals, sauces, seasonings, flavourings and beverages.
* Open the first opportunities in adjacent sectors as we extend the product into adjacent sectors, and feed what you learn back into product and pricing.
* Qualify hard and early. We would rather have a smaller pipeline we believe in than a large one we do not.
2. Selling and Closing
* Run the full sales cycle: discovery, on-site assessment, demonstration (in person and remote), proposal, commercial negotiation and close.
* Build the business case in the customer’s language: reduced giveaway and waste, right first time batches, allergen control, audit-ready evidence and labour saved on the weigh-up line.
* Prepare and present quotations and proposals that reflect our pricing model, including site-level and tiered packaging.
* Present our solution accurately and never oversell what the product does. Where a requirement needs bespoke development, involve the technical team for scope.
* Hand over cleanly to Projects and Support at the point of sale, including a written summary of what has been sold and what the customer expects.
3. Market, Product and Competitor Knowledge
* Build and hold working knowledge of the FORMIX proposition and enough of the wider portfolio to spot an opportunity when a customer describes a problem.
* Know the competition. Be able to explain where we win and where we do not.
* Gather field intelligence on competitor pricing, bundling and contract terms.
* Track sector trends, regulation and retailer or certification pressures (for example BRCGS) that create a reason for customers to act.
4. Pipeline, CRM and Reporting
* Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of sufficient size and quality to deliver the agreed targets, with realistic close dates and values.
* Keep CRM current and accurate. Every opportunity, activity, contact and next step is logged.
* Report weekly on activity, pipeline movement and forecast, and present your numbers at commercial reviews.
* Learn and follow the company sales guidelines and standard operating procedures, and help improve our proposal and correspondence templates as you go.
* Use AI tools in your daily workflow: prospect and account research, first-draft proposals and follow-ups, call preparation and pipeline analysis. We will give you the tools and the training.
5. Working With the Team
* Work with the Account Managers so that new business and account growth do not collide, and pass leads to them where an opportunity sits inside an existing relationship.
* Work with Development, Projects and Support on solution scoping, demonstrations and delivery expectations.
* Contribute to campaigns, marketing content, case studies and event planning.
* Attend training to keep product, sector and sales skills current, and take part in team meetings and reviews.
* Carry out other reasonable duties related to the promotion, sale and delivery of our products as directed by the management team.
Targets and Measures of Success
You will carry a personal new business target, set annually with the Head of Commercial and reviewed each quarter. It covers new order value, new recurring revenue and a minimum number of genuinely new clients, and it is supported by activity and pipeline coverage measures and by the quality of what you put into the CRM.
The targets are built from our FORMIX commercial plan and are deliberately achievable for someone who prospects properly. We will share the detail, including the numbers and how the commission scheme works against them, at the interview stage.
**Qualifications and Experience**
Essential
* Proven track record of winning new business in a B2B environment, carrying and hitting a personal new business target.
* Experience selling a considered purchase with a multi-month sales cycle and more than one decision maker, typically operations, quality, engineering, IT and finance.
* Comfortable self-generating pipeline.
* Able to hold a credible conversation on a factory floor and translate an operational problem into a commercial proposal.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, including the ability to write a proposal that stands on its own.
* Strong negotiation and closing skills, with the discipline to protect margin.
* Confident with CRM discipline and accurate forecasting.
* Comfortable using AI tools as part of your working day. You do not need to be technical, but you do need to be someone who reaches for them rather than avoids them.
* Full UK driving licence, and willing to travel across the UK, including overnight stays. Most of our target market sits in a band from the Midlands up through Yorkshire and the Humber into the North West, so a home base within reach of that corridor is an advantage, though we will consider strong candidates anywhere in the UK.
Desirable
* Experience selling into food and drink manufacturing, or into another regulated manufacturing sector.
* Familiarity with MES, ERP, traceability, weighing or labelling systems, or with production and quality processes in a manufacturing plant.
* Experience selling a combined hardware, software and services solution rather than software alone.
* Experience opening a new market or launching a new product into an existing customer base.
* A strong existing network of contacts in food and drink manufacturing, at operations, quality, engineering or director level. If you can open doors on day one, tell us.
